descriptionByLocale.it:
The actual location of this job is in Stücki, Switzerland. For our successful Drug Product (DP) focused branch located in Basel and Stein, Switzerland, we have exciting opportunities. Become part of a group that enables its customers to meet some of the greatest challenges in patient treatment and join us by applying for the Internship QA Compliance position. What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture
• An inclusive and ethical workplace
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance What you will do: Support the QA Compliance team for Lonza DPS Basel and Stein related to quality systems, training, audits, authority inspections, supplier qualification and quality agreement management. Specifically the role will focus on:
• Customer audit scheduling
• Preparation of project-specific documentation
• Supporting quality metrics and data analytics activities
• Contributing to ongoing QA Compliance projects, including system implementation and maintenance What we are looking for:
• Bachelor, Master or PhD degree in life sciences or pharmaceutical sciences
• Quality focused and optimization mindset
• Experienced in data handling and visualization
• Strong analytical abilities and good communication/presentation skills
• Prior exposure to cGMP practices and pharmaceutical industry experience preferred
• Excellent knowledge of written and spoken English and German required About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
